t: Meet with Leon de Grandeur at the exchange point between the Blackened Shore and the Wild Gorge.

Very well, I have made my decision!
We'll conduct a joint operation with the Empire. As our first step toward cooperation, we will complete a prisoner swap. Not long ago the Imperial troops captured Maxim Lukov, a scout of ours, just as we arrested one of their scouts. We will send a dispatch to the Imperial camp with instructions and the location of the designated point of exchange.
It's the halfway mark between the Imperial camp and ours. Leon de Grandeur, our overseer, is already there. Please go as quickly as possible and make sure that this exchange goes off without a hitch!

Our prisoner will be here any minute. You know, being captured by the enemy is no picnic. I was a POW myself a while back. That's when the Empire demanded ten captive Orcs in return for one Elf - me. The Orcs resented me for it... And I guess I can totally understand why. Anyway, my commander thought the offer was too lopsided and refused, even though feeding those Orcs was neither cheap nor easy. But then my brothers organized a raid on the enemy camp and released me!
Wait for the prisoner exchange to be completed.

They'll be bringing in our scout soon, let's hope everything goes smoothly...
But I wouldn't put too much stock in the Empire's honor! Keep your eyes open and wait here until the swap has been completed. I've served many years in the army and there's no way that I can remember every single dirty trick that the Imperial forces have tried to pull just in the span of my service! They're twisted!
Wait! The exchange hasn't been completed. I'm ready for any surprises!

I'm glad that everything turned out well. Perhaps I was too much of a cynic. I admit, I thought that this United Array was just some ridiculous joke... Or worse - a provocation by the Empire. I didn't believe that old enemies could unite for the sake of a common goal. But now I see the purpose behind this venture!
Relay Leon de Grandeur's message to Rogneda Boykova in the League Settlement.

I guess it all worked out after all. You better return to Rogneda and report on the outcome!
Tell her that Leon de Grandeur is pleased with the exchange and is of the opinion that the Empire can be trusted. Now, hurry! She's waiting on my assessment of the situation!

That Leon de Grandeur is as grumpy and mistrustful an Elf as you'll ever meet. So if he says that the Empire can be trusted, you can take that to the bank. If they were planning some trick, Leon would know - he has a sense for these things!
Relay Evgeny Byvalin's message to Adam Verkhovin.

I have made my decision! For the sake of my daughter - no, for the sake of all of us - I must take the risk. I may be accused of treason and given the ultimate punishment by our government, but I don't care. Let them! At least I'll die knowing I did everything I could to save Sarnaut.
Go to Verkhovin and tell him about the United Array. Tell him about my part in it, and that many other veterans are backing us. Tell him that our only chance to survive on this allod is to ally with the League. As it was in the Great Astral Campaign, so it shall be again.

The United Array? Does our government know about this? My guess is no. If they had, I bet most of our veterans would be in jail right now!
Hm, I might be accused of treason if I start negotiations with the enemy. On the other hand, the demons are closing in on all sides and we can barely hold this camp. Should I choose a final death on this damned allod, or life in an Imperial prison? Well, I suppose the answer is obvious.
Meet with Snowdrift the Nomadic to the west of the Wild Gorge.

I'm ready to cooperate with the League. I think we should begin by exchanging prisoners.
From what I understand, scouts from each side were intentionally captured to open up discussions about the United Array. If this story is true and the League is ready to cooperate, then they should have no problem returning Tamara. In return, we will give the League the Kanian scout we captured.
I'm going to send a messenger to relay our terms to the League commanders. The proposed meeting place is along the coast to the west of the Wild Gorge. The exchange shall be led by Snowdrift the Nomadic on our side.
I want you to go just to make sure things go smoothly. There better not be any surprises! I'm not about to trust the League just yet. They've been known to pull some nasty tricks in the past.

I ain't keen on Elves. They're always so pompous and surly! It looks like the one that's representing the League in this little exchange ain't any different.
I remember when I was serving in the Holy Land my squad captured an Elf. Our commander offered the League a swap - our pointy-eared bastard in return for ten captive Orcs! One friggin' dandy for ten genuine warriors - can you imagine that? What's so special about those lanky bastards anyhow?!
Wait for the prisoners to be exchanged.

I don't trust the League as far as I could throw them! And those Elves especially. This story with the "United Array" sounds pretty suspicious if you ask me. It could be some kind of trap!
You see, the last thing the League wants is for us to prevail over the demons! I'm sure their commander will do whatever they can to stop that from happening. If I were Verkhovin, I wouldn't give her the time of day.
That said, I have orders that command me to stand here all nice and patient until the exchange is complete. But don't take your eyes off the enemy - who knows what they might pull! Especially that arrogant Elf!
Hold on, the exchanges not complete yet! They could still attack us at any moment!

Well, all's well that ends well. What a touching scene, eh?! It seems that the "United Array" wasn't some sort of bluff! Which means they're about to get a new member - me! I'm a veteran myself, after all.
I never thought I'd find myself fighting on the same side as the League! But I suppose the demons aren't the greatest enemy right now. I'll just try and stay as far away from the Elves as possible.
Report the success of the prisoner exchange to Adam Verkhovin in the Imperial Settlement.

Return to Verkhovin and tell him that the prisoner exchange was successful. This "United Array" was neither made up nor a trap. Now we need to organize a joint operation with the League and strike the enemy together! Go now while I discuss some plans with their captain.

I've been sitting here on pins and needles the whole time. I'd feel like such a fool if the League betrayed us. So, what happened?
I see. If Snowdrift trusts the League then everything is fine. Nobody could fool that old Orc. Well, now we know that this "United Array" is real. Our veterans have united with the League veterans to fight a common enemy.
After everything's over I hope our leaders will see things for what they are. We must now cooperate with Rogneda Boykova, the leader of the League troops, if we are to have a chance at winning the war against the cursed demons!

Use the Signal Flare, activate the Demonic Artifact, and channel the artifact's power for 5 minutes until the demonic portal is sealed. Search the defeated Demons' bodies for anything useful and return to Rogneda Boykova.

The Imperial commander, Adam Verkhovin, and I have worked out a plan. The enemy's main military forces are concentrated in the portal dimension of this demon network. Our only chance to prevent a global catastrophe is to seal them there!
Two of the network's portals are located inside our camps and the third is by the Gates. Your mission is to set this magic artifact by the third portal. The artifact is tuned to the magic of our paladins and the Imperial mages and it works in unison with their spells.
When the artifact is in place, fire a signal flare and we will commence the operation at once! But remember, the artifact must remain intact for at least five minutes - otherwise we won't be able to complete the operation. Protect it at all costs!
Aidenus won't be happy with me taking matters into my own hands. He'll probably send me off to Siveria, where I'll spend the rest of my days shuffling through snow...

Excellent! The end justifies the means and success is never punished! If we didn't stop the demons, they would have destroyed us and then moved on through to the League portal network and pillaged our cities. The only thing that prevented this catastrophe was our alliance with the Empire. I will draft up a report for Aidenus, he must understand that we simply had no alternative.
Charge the Final Argument with magic energy by eliminating 6 Malevolent Demon Mages. Report back to the League Defenders' commander Rogneda Boykova.

Wait!
Before you go on the Third Portal mission, I have to tell you something else...
You can complete this quest on your own. By using magic, of course. When he sent me here, Aidenus decided to give me something from his own stash... And I think now is the proper time to put the Final Argument to use. That's the name of the artifact he gave me. But before you can use it, you must charge it with the power of six bested enemies. Malevolent Demon Mages will do just fine.
I wish I could at least steal a glance at Aidenus' treasury! I think it holds some... unimaginably powerful artifacts!

Holy cow! Looking at this charged artifact I'm beginning to understand why it got its name!
You'll surely close the third portal with it. As long as you don't forget to use it when the demons attack!.
Charge the Final Argument with magic energy by eliminating 6 Malevolent Demon Mages. Report back to Adam Verkhovin.

Before you go on the Third Portal mission, I want to tell you something.
If you don't want to share your glory with anyone, you can succeed on your own. I have a suitable artifact for that. It's called the Final Argument. Yasker himself gave it to me before sending me to this dump. "Just in case," he said.
But the artifact needs to be charged first. By killing enemies, of course. And Malevolent Demon Mages are the best creatures for this. As the manual says... Wait a sec... Right there! Six demons!
To sum up, if you decide to complete the Third Portal mission on your own, charge the Final Argument by eliminating six demons.

Heh, those Great Mages!
They sure got a nice supply of toys... All sorts of things that will come in handy in any situation!

Wow, that artifact radiates immense power!
I'm sure it can help you successfully accomplish the Third Portal mission. Just use its power when the demons start attacking you.
Are you sure you are ready to fight demons ?
Great! Let's fight the demon scum!
Speak with Dmitry Svetlov about the Blood-Etched Key.

This key is covered with dark red runes and seems to be full of demonic energy... Perhaps it could be the key to the Demon City?
At any rate, it's clearly magical... If anyone could shed some light on this, it would be Dmitry Svetlov. You better go speak with him.
What are you still doing hanging around here? I thought you'd be out in the thick of it by now.
Oh! What have you there? That clearly once belonged to the demons! A trophy of war?

Use the Signal Flare, activate the Demonic Artifact, and channel the artifact's power for 5 minutes until the demonic portal is sealed. Search the defeated cultists' bodies for anything useful and return to Adam Verkhovin.

Listen up. After some written correspondences Rogneda Boykova and I have put together a plan. We know that there are many demons and cultists waiting in the portal dimension until they're ordered to attack.
Out of the three portals on this allod, one is in the League settlement, one is in the Imperial settlement, and one is near the Demonic Gates. The first two have already been sealed, leaving only the third one open. If we seal that one as well, all who remain inside the portal dimension will be trapped there forever.
Take this demonic artifact. It's tuned to the demonic portals and with the help of our mages it can be used to seal one. Use this signal flare at the portal near the Demonic Gate so our mage's will know when to channel their power into it. Then use the artifact and hold it near the portal until their spells are finished.
Unfortunately, holding the artifact is going to be very exhausting. In fact, you might not even be able to move. On top of that, the enemy is certain to try and destroy the artifact. Make sure to bring your most trusted friends to help guard you during this mission.
If we don't defeat the demons Yasker will have my head for this unauthorized alliance with the League. Hurry up and complete the operation!

Hurray! The portal's finally sealed! Well done!
Traditionally, pacts with the enemy can only be made with the consent of Yasker himself. However, this situation was critical. We had to work with the League. They could have crushed both our settlements and then flooded into our cities, destroying the world as we know it!
In light of all that I hope that Yasker forgives my actions. I stand by my decision and will never regret it!
Bring the Blood-Etched Key to Yaver Khaba.

This key is covered with dark red runes. It seems to be full of demonic energy. Perhaps it could be the key to the demons' city? It's clearly magical, so if anyone would know the answer it would be Yaver Khaba.
Our efforts to keep the portal closed have been a huge success thanks to you! Keep up the good work!
Equip a Shadowy Hood, Shadowy Robe, and Shadowy Spaulders and test the Blood-Etched Key near the Demonic Gates. Report your results to Rogneda Boykova.

A demon had this key with him...? Could it be? Could this be the key to open the Demonic Gates? The key to their city? You should check and see if it opens them! Hmm... But if they see you like that, they'll tear you to pieces... You should get a disguise for yourself!
You didn't sneak in? I thought you were more adept at stealth.
Glad to see you alive and well! What were you able to find out?
Equip a Shadowy Hood, Shadowy Robe, and Shadowy Spaulders and test the Blood-Etched Key near the Demonic Gates. Report your results to Adam Verkhovin.

This could be the key to the Demonic Gates! That Elven cultist must have been using it to get inside. This hypothesis needs to be tested immediately!
You should disguise yourself as a cultist before you try this trick. I don't want to imagine what would happen if you stumbled into their lair looking like an Imperial soldier! Steal some of their clothes and then test the key. Report your results to Verkhovin as soon as you're done!
Writing this report to Yasker was incredibly difficult. I hope our great leader will take all of my arguments into account. Especially if we end up winning this battle!

What's this? A key to the Demonic Gates? But... it didn't work, you say? Hm. Well, it's still an interesting find. Perhaps our agents back in Nezebgrad could learn something from studying it. I'll send it to them immediately. Thank you for your work!
Collect 12 Black Dragon Teeth for Veleslav Muromov.

Everything has been turned upside down! It's all topsy-turvy! And vice versa.
What do you know about dragons? One would think that they're all enemies of the demons, right? Well, that's how it used to be. But now? Black dragons here are working with the demons! Why? Well, I haven't the foggiest...
But let's be honest, we have never been friends with dragons. It's been like that for a long time. Maybe that's why they got along with demons. They say that even the ancient Junes hunted dragons. And now, I've heard, some are ready to challenge the Great Dragons.
But I can't entrust you with such a matter. It's dangerous. But the dragons that live on the Blackened Shore are a tasty morsel. And I'm interested in the fangs of these creatures. Why? Bring me a dozen pieces and I'll tell you why.
Well, do you have the dragon teeth?
Well done! Now we have fewer enemies to worry about.
Collect 12 Black Dragon Teeth for Sarbaz Takelot.

An interesting phenomenon has been observed here on Yazes Shard. Very interesting.
Here, listen.
First: The demons have always been enemies of dragons. Second: Black dragons obey other dragons. Which means they should be enemies of demons too, right?
But that's not the case. As it turns out, black dragons are allied with demons! A paradox!
I'm sure that sooner or later we'll find the reason behind this. But for now we should use this opportunity!
You see, dragons are made of some pretty tough stuff. Strong skin, sharp fangs, et cetera. Even the Great Mages had an interest in these resources. Black dragons are also quite valuable. Especially when it comes to their sharp fangs.
Bring me a dozen Fangs of Black Dragons and I will reward you.
Even the ancient Zem knew how useful dragon teeth were for making weapons. We can't pass up any resources on this harsh allod.
Well done. These teeth will make strong and deadly weapons. Here's a reward for your trouble.
Collect 6 measures of Evil Eye Slime for Viktoria Mekhova.

"Use the red with red and the blue with blue." That's what the Order of Mercy taught me. But it doesn't work here! The demonic corruption the wounds of our Defenders just won't heal! There's no stopping it - the rot is growing and taking over the healthy parts of the flesh!
The only solution that we've found to stop the spreading is to just cut off the infected limb completely! But what am I supposed to do?! I can't just let their bodies rot completely!
But I have an idea... I think that if we can use the evil eyes' slime, it can help to stop the rot. That stuff can melt a diamond! Go get me some slime and we'll see how it works!
That's nowhere near enough! We need more!
Thank you - this will help us until we can get a proper cure!
Collect 6 particles of Elemental Flame from the Lava Elementals for Klara Zhilina.

Great Nezeb, Skrakan, and even Tensess! The wounded keep arriving and arriving. The Servants of the Light are capable of many things... but not quite miracles.
These wounds inflicted by the demons are horrific. Dark energy spreads throughout the wounded very quickly, and sometimes the only option is to amputate the infected part. Half of those who become injured end up disabled!
There is one remedy. If we cauterize the wounds with powerful flames the infections can be stopped from spreading. Such flames can be found on the fire elementals to the west. Verkhovin is too busy to send out soldiers to collect them for us, but perhaps you can help?
I've seen the war in the Holy Land so I thought I was ready for anything. How wrong I was!
Thank you! Now I'll be able to save dozens of soldiers.

Listen to me very carefully. What I'm about to tell you is top secret. Secondly, it's... well... extremely confusing. To be honest, I don't quite understand it all myself.
Recently some government officials had an important meeting. We mostly talked about demons. We heard reports about their appearance in the Holy Land, Coldberg, Avilon, and Dragon Ring.
You know, when you hear it all at once it's very unsettling. It's as if they're poking their noses everywhere, trying to destroy all of the allods. And they seem to be surrounded by necromancers and vampires! And we can't forget that Gorluxor... Argh! I hate him!
Anyway, it was officially acknowledged that the demonic threat hasn't been eliminated. They're definitely planning a new assault on Sarnaut. It was decided that they need to be dealt with immediately.
Yasker himself is in charge of this mission. All the soldiers who are chosen for it will be sworn to secrecy. If the general population found out about the demons there'd be utter chaos!
Go see Yasker immediately. He asked to speak with you personally. I'm sure he has a complicated mission and he needs a reliable soldier to do it - someone just like you.
At last you're here. I was waiting for you. So, are you willing to help the Empire once again?
Go to Nezebgrad and give Yasker Verkhovin's Report and the Blood-Etched Key.

Please go to Yasker and give him my latest report as well as this strange key. Let's hope that he forgives us for our cooperation with the League. I know that your service to the Empire has been very great, so I'm sure he'll be more understanding if you're the messenger.
Before you go I'd like to officially thank you for all you've done on Yazes Shard. We're far from winning this battle, but thanks to you we've been able to hold our ground. May Nezeb watch over you!
I sent the best of the best to Yazes Shard. They were supposed to steal the victory over the demons from the League! And what happened in the end? They actually allied with them!

Well... what's done is done. If we ignore the shocking details, this mission may be considered a success. A whole army of demons has been forever sealed in the portal dimension. The threat of imminent invasion has passed. Perhaps I'll bend the rules a little this time.
I'll instruct the propaganda department to present these events in a favorable light. Our citizens will believe the Empire played the leading role in this victory. Thank you for bringing me this report.
Speak with Elizaveta Rysina at the bottom of Yasker's Tower.

So, what do we have so far?
Frankly, very little. First of all, our soldiers are still on the defensive. Secondly, while this key would be very valuable if it opened the Demonic Gates, right now it does nothing.
 What's that? Perhaps it only works with those who have proven their loyalty? Some sort of attunement, eh? Hm... Well, the City Council knows a good deal about these cultists. They might not have the answer to this problem, but I'm sure they'll have some clues to a solution.
Visit Elizaveta Rysina and ask her to tell you everything she knows about the cultists. We must get into their main city!
This must be important if Yasker gave you emergency clearance to this information. Well, let me try and tell you everything we know.
Go to Yazes Shard, summon a demon along the northeastern shore, and give him all of the information about Tep.

You now need to make contact with this "master". More precisely, with his henchmen. You have to give them everything you gathered from all of your heroic adventures.
Fortunately the Teonomicon lists a way to get in contact with them. You need to go back to Yazes Shard. On the northeastern shore there is a place where they conduct rituals. If you use the ritualistic dagger to make a cut in your palm at this location, one of the demons will be drawn to you.
Hm. I don't know much about the demons' customs. It's probably best for you not to say anything. Just bow your head, give them the items, and see what the demon says. Hopefully they'll give you a key to the Demonic Gate.
Hm, the flesh of Mor'Ghuun, the papers of Tep cultists, and one of Tep's devices. Well done. The master will be pleased with your work.
Return to Yasker with the Blood-Etched Key and the Ritualistic Dagger.

Take this key to the Demonic Gates. You've earned a place among the elite. But remember that more will be expected of you now. And the master does not tolerate failure!
I expect you to report to the Fortified Courtyard within the hour. You'll receive new orders when you get there. Now go.

This news is both wonderful and terrifying. It's good that we can finally get into our enemies' main headquarters. We'll finally be able to put them on the defensive.
But this also means the beginning of a larger war - one against the demons and whoever their master is. The future will be filled with much bloodshed. I hope you will continue to serve your country in these dark times.
Read the three books about the demons and the cultists and return to Elizaveta Rysina.

The cultists and the demons go to great lengths to protect their secrets. They're fanatics willing to die for their ideals, but unfortunately we don't know what they are.
I must admit that after the closure of the June Portal I thought the demonic threat had been eliminated. Since then we haven't paid much attention to the cultists, but perhaps we were wrong.
We have a few documents around the office that summarize our knowledge and them and the demons. I grant you permission to read them.
Make sure to look at "The History of the Demon Invasion", "The Origins of the Cultists", and "Excerpts from the Teonomicon".
Familiarize yourself with all the documents. You must know your enemy!
Now you know as much as we do. That means it's time to enact the next part of the plan.
Head to the monument in Victory Park and use the Advanced Paralyzer on the cultists' leader.

We know that there's many cultists right here in Nezebgrad and we recently captured one of them. He's being held by the City Council in a magical field that prevents him from committing suicide.
We haven't learned much from interrogating him. From what we have determined he's only recently joined their ranks. That means he doesn't know much anyway. The most interesting thing that we've found out is that the cultists have a list of their enemies. The list is apparently quite long and even has your name on it.
Since the cultists want you dead that means you'll make excellent bait. I'll have the media make an urgent announcement that the Imperial Survivor has returned to the capital. We'll say you're making a pilgrimage to the memorial in Victory Park.
As soon as you get there the cultists should attack you. When they do our agents will come out of hiding and attack them. Our goal is to capture their leader. He'll definitely try to commit suicide, so use this paralyzer on him immediately. Then we can take him into custody!
Don't draw too much attention to me! I'm just supposed to be an ordinary citizen.
Outstanding work! It seems the poor devil doesn't even understand what happened!
Return to Elizaveta Rysina at the bottom of Yasker's Tower.

It's unsettling to know there are cultists among our ranks. The faster we expose them the better. Return to Rysina and report on the success of this operation. I'm sure she'll have further orders for you.
You did a great job! The plan worked perfectly. We already have our best agents interrogating the cultist. Let me fill you in on the details.
Go to the cultists' house in the Astral Quarter, retrieve the Teonomicon and the Ritualistic Dagger, and bring them to Elizaveta Rysina.

With the use of psionic powers our agents have already discovered something important.
Apparently the cultist has a complete copy of the Teonomicon is his house! This is an extremely important document. It must be retrieved as quickly as possible before his allies remove all the evidence. His home is located in the Astral Quarter. Go there and find this book.
Also look for a certain knife. We're not sure why it's important, but the prisoner is constantly thinking about it. It might be used in important rituals.
Faster! It won't take long for the cultists to find out what's going on!
Excellent! We finally have a complete copy of the Teonomicon! Maybe we can finally discover the cultists' intentions.
Ask Elizaveta Rysina about her conclusions.

Hmm... this isn't just a book. There are dates, summaries about the cult, demons, missions... It appears to be more like a diary of their activities!
Let's flip to the part about their most recent mission... It says that some "master" ordered them to find Tep. Apparently his power could make him an ally or a problem. The passage goes on to say that this "master" ordered them to gather information about Tep.
Apparently those who aide in this task will be granted access to a "Seventh Circle". It seems to be some sort of elite privilege. I wonder if it would allow you to enter the Demonic Gates. Hmm, I need to think about what all this means.

You must gain the cultists' trust at any costs. You need to gain the power of this "Seventh Circle" so that you can get past the Demonic Gates. That means you're going to help them with this mission. Gather information about Tep for their master. I think I know a few places you should start looking.
Meet with the Great Mage Aidenus in Novograd.

There's something terrible transpiring. Let's look at the clues... The demons teamed up with a necromancer in Coldberg to try to destroy the allod and deprive us of our meteorite ore. That was only the beginning.
Next, the demons teamed up with the vampires in Avilon to try and destroy another allod... the one controlled by the Great Mage Zayan and the Historians.
Their third target was the Great Dragon who controls Dragon Ring in and attempt to destroy yet another allod. You see, a Great Dragon can uphold an allod just as well as a Great Mage and meteorite ore.
And can you remember what happened before all that? The Sites of Power in the Holy Land all got defiled, Gorluxor started his uprising, and Tensess himself asked us to unite against the demonic threat!
Are you sensing a pattern here? It's possible that the demonic threat hasn't yet been neutralized! Keep your mouth shut about it - there's no need to start spreading panic! We'll need to check it out more first. Go speak with Aidenus about what needs to be done next. I believe that he's been looking for you.
There you are. I've been expecting you. Listen carefully because I must share matters of great importance with you.
Return to Novograd and give Aidenus Rogneda Boykova's Report and the Blood-Etched Key.

I need you to deliver the key to the Demonic Gates with my report of our successful operation to Aidenus at once!
I hope our collaboration with the Empire won't be cause for any punishment... After all, this was done for the greater good!
But I don't need to tell any of this to you! I've already explained everything in the letter, so please take it to Aidenus right away. Good luck!

Now, that's some news! I knew that Rogneda would have no trouble with those damned demons with you at her side! What I didn't expect was that the whole thing would end in a joint operation with Imperial forces.

It's interesting that the Empire would agree to a plan such as this...
Hah! I bet that Yasker is having a fit right about now. And I would be too if not for the extraordinary circumstances on Yazes Shard. Decisions on joint action and cooperation are to be made by me and not the commanders!
But I suppose that this is a case where the ends justify the means... The threat of invasion has been eliminated and the demon army is forever locked in their own portal. This is a great victory!
Speak with Marianne de Ardeur, the Divine Prioress, about the cultists.

What do we know about this City? Hmm... Unfortunately, not much.
Our troops are still on the defensive out there and this key does nothing. Well, not "nothing." It did tell you that you weren't worthy enough to enter. Perhaps it only works for those that have proven their loyalty?
If there's anyone who knows anything about those cultists, it's the Church. They might not have all the answers, but even a tiny clue is better than nothing. Go speak with Marianne.
Greetings. I was told that you were coming.
Hm... This truly is an odd knife... Maybe I can find a few customers that would be interested in this.
Return to Yazes Shard and use the Obsidian Sacrificial Knife to make a blood offering to the Astral on the shore of the Baneful Valley.

Now for the most important job – it's time to call on the "Master." You must offer all that you've obtained - Mor'Ghuun's flesh, the necromantic device, and the ZIT's papers - to the Master.
Listen up and follow my instructions carefully. The Teonomicon says you must return to Yazes Shard and visit the shore of the Baneful Valley. There you will use the Obsidian knife to offer your blood as a gift to the Astral. After that, a demon will appear and you will give him your items.
What happens next is unknown... I will pray for you! Good luck!
Yes? Why have you called me?
The flesh of Mor'Ghuun, a Tep device, and the papers on the Tep incident at ZIT... The Master will be pleased with your work.
Return to Aidenus with the Blood-Etched Key and the Obsidian Sacrificial Knife.

Take this key to the Demonic Gates. You've earned your place among the elite.
But remember, more will be expected of you from now on and the master does not tolerate failure!
I expect you to report to the Fortified Courtyard within the hour. You'll receive new orders once you arrive. Now go.
Did something happen? Well, don't delay, speak up!

This news is both wonderful and terrifying. Once inside, we'll finally be able to put them on the defensive.
But this also means the beginning of a larger war - one against the demons and their master. Our future will be filled with much bloodshed...
Read The History of the Demon Invasion, The Origins of the Cultists, and Excerpts from the Teonomicon and speak with Marianne de Ardeur.

You want more information about the cultists? Well, we don't have much on them but I do have some notes that might help.
I suggest that you read three books that we have on the subject.
First, The History of the Demon Invasion – it's a chronological account from when we first discovered the Astral portals to the state of the demons today.
Second, The Origins of the Cultists – our own private notes that members of the Church have taken on the subject. There are many gaps in our information, but it's the best we have.
Finally, Excerpts from the Teonomicon - the cultists' sacred book. It describes their great mission in depth. It's a terrifying but necessary read.
Wonderful. Now you know as much as we do.
Post the announcement on the Bulletin Board, visit Foma Upryamov, and return to Marianne de Ardeur.

We know there's a cultist sect in our very own capital, but we haven't been able to trace them yet.
One of their most important artifacts is a sacrificial knife, and it was recently stolen from them by one of our agents. My suggestion is to spread a rumor that you stole it. They'll hear that rumor and come looking for you immediately!
First we'll need to post a flyer about the theft on the bulletin board and describe a suspect that matches your description... This will make the claim look more legitimate.
Then you'll need to pay a visit to Foma Upryamov, our resident trafficker, and offer to let him buy the stolen artifact from you. The cultists keep in touch with the trafficker, so they'll hear about this news right away. Return to me when you're done.
It's such a shame. Foma was such a good boy in church... I pray to the Light for his soul!
Excellent! Their attack on you is just a matter of time!
Speak with Foma Upryamov and place the Magic Mark on the cultists' Leader when they attack. Die and then return to Marianne de Ardeur.

I have a new task for you. I want you to visit the trafficker - I'd be willing to bet that the cultists are already lying in wait for you there.
But the cultists are known for their fanaticism... even if they can be taken prisoner, they won't say a word! They say that they'd rather die.
So here's what I propose... I want you to take this magic mark and secure it to the leader of the bunch. But then you'll have to die – and make it look convincing!
After your resurrection, return to the church for new instructions. That magical mark will help us to follow the cultists and stake out their lair. Here, take this dagger with you for added credibility - the cultists won't suspect a thing.
Those cultists think they're so smart... Tee hee.
Oh! There you are. Do you think they bought it?
Find and penetrate the Cultists' Lair, retrieve the Knife, and find any and all information regarding the cultists.

Look! The magic mark is working! Now we know where those cultists are hiding!
You want to get even with those cultists for killing you, right?
Well then, you better get over to their hideout! It looks like they're holed up in the Trade District, near the monument to the Great Mage! Scoundrels!
You need to break in and search their lair. We need documents, books, and letters, anything that will help us to understand who they are and what they're after. And, of course, retrieve the sacrificial knife. Hurry, now!
Hurry - the cultists are not fools! They'll soon discover the mark!
Excellent - thanks to these documents, we'll be able to learn much more about the cultists.
Wait while Marianne de Ardeur checks the other copies of the Teonomicon.

I don't understand... This is exactly the same as what we already know. Look, these are pages from the Teonomicon!
Oh... Wait, there's more. Why, it's a journal! It even has a record of orders and reports. This changes everything!
I bet that each cultist has his own journal like this that gets destroyed during the first sign of danger. We must examine all the copies of the Teonomicon that we have! Stay right here, this'll be quick.

Okay, so, the leaders of the cultists groups have been given an order to gather as much information possible on Tep. It seems as if Tep is the only person capable of preventing the "Master" from carrying out his plans.
It looks like Marcel de Doucer was promised a spot in the seventh round, whatever that is, as a reward for bringing Tep in as an ally!

This is exactly what we need! You'll need to play the part of Marcel de Doucer... You'll carry out the orders of this mysterious "Master" and infiltrate the Demonic Gates! Tensess forgive us for going down the path of darkness... But this is all in the name of the Light!
Use the Scroll of Teleportation to travel to Yazes Shard and meet with Adam Verkhovin.

It is now time to address the heart of the matter. The keys you found at Avilon allowed the demons and their minions to us our teleportation network. We used the key of Armando de Doucer to pinpoint the location he had been visiting most often. It appears that it's some remote allod named Yazes Shard.
It used to be a large Imperial allod, but it was captured by the demons during the Great Astral Campaign and over the years most of it was destroyed by the Astral. However, it's still a sizeable piece of land and it's now the home of one of our greatest enemies - Gorluxor.
We believe that most of the cultists and demons are concentrated on this allod. At their head is Gorluxor who's using them in his plots for world domination. We're sure the demons are using him for their own purposes as well, but at the moment we're uncertain of their motives.
I've already sent some troops to the allods to complete a secret operation codenamed "The Phantom Menace". You are now a member of this team and are to report to Yazes Shard immediately.
This scroll of teleportation will take you directly to our main base. Once you're there, speak to General Adam Verkhovin. He'll give you further instructions.

Right now there are more demons and cultists than we could have imagined. On our very first day here half of the troops were lost. Since then we've been on the defensive.
To the west of here are a group of League soldiers. The League somehow found out about our operation here and sent their best forces to battle these agents of darkness. But Yasker hopes that we will be the ones to destroy the demons. It would be a grand victory for the Empire!
Unfortunately, there's a long way to go before we're victorious. This certainly won't be easy.
Use the Scroll of Teleportation to travel to Yazes Shard and meet with Rogneda Boykova, the League Campaign Leader.

The keys you recovered from Armando de Doucer's teleporter has helped our intelligence to gain access the demons' portal network. It looks like most of their activity leads to Yazes Shard – an allod formerly under control of the Empire.
A squad of paratroopers has already been deployed to the allod and is headed by Rogneda Boykova. When they got there, they found many demons and cultists as well as the home of our greatest enemy - Gorluxor's Tower.
There's no doubt that this place is their headquarters. There Gorluxor leads his large army of demons and cultists in an attempt at world domination. We're sure the demons are using him too, but we're not sure what their goals are.
This operation has been classified as top secret and given the name the codename "A New Hope." We hope that one day soon, we can clear the world of this demonic plague. You are to join this team of soldiers immediately. Take this scroll - it will teleport you to Yazes shard. Once there, report to Commander Rogneda Boykova for more information.
Did Aidenus send you to help? Excellent!

We really didn't expect to find so many demons and cultists here... They nearly pushed us into the Astral. Our only goal for the moment is survival.
Those demons out there are preparing for a new invasion, they want to get rid of us! Their attacks are non-stop! Fortunately, a good chunk of the demons are distracted by the Imperial paratroopers working the eastern shore.
Yes, Imperial intelligence has also found out about Yazes Shard and Yasker deployed a squad to this area. We're trying to steer clear of them - Aidenus wants us to be the ones to deal with this demon problem. Our victory will consolidate the League's prestige. Unfortunately, it'll be very difficult to win this battle.
Read the info on signposts in the Trade District, on the Terrace of Truth and in the Master's Sanctuary. Also, meet the Keepers.

The Master, also known as the director of the greatest play in the world, is glad to see you in his Citadel!
No more games... Soon playing will turn into reality and maybe you will play the leading part. There will be some serious disturbances in Sarnaut, but here, in the Master's Citadel, you will be safe. Look around. Here you will find everything that a Seeker of Truth like you may need.
The Bank and Auction operate without delay, in spite of the huge distance between here and the capital Allod. You will find everything you might need in the Trade District.
The Astral Academy Gates will lead you to the Hangar where your Astral Ship is kept.
On the Terrace of Truth you will meet the Keepers, who will guide you in your search for truth. They are the voice of the Master!
In the Master's Sanctuary hovering above the Citadel, Seekers of Truth can take a rest while thinking and observing.
The only door which you cannot open leads to the Master's Chamber. Maybe in the future, as you begin to understand more things, this door will open and you will meet the Master himself.
Take a walk, look around. You will have to spend a lot of time in the Citadel, as the path to enlightenment is long and winding. Don't forget to meet the Keepers on the Terrace of Truth. They can tell you more about the part you are to play in the greatest play in the world.
The Citadel is great but it is nothing compared to the true magnificence that the Master is capable of.
How do you like the Citadel? It is one of the Master's great masterpieces, but not the greatest!

On the Terrace of Truth, you will find Master's attendants who are awaiting visitors to convey them the Master's will, Citadel Keeper who rewards adventurers for completing quests in Master's name, and a portal available for traveling between allods.
Take the Astral Boat, travel to Draconid Island and meet Alexey Borodin, the Ambassador of the Hunters.

I am the Keeper of Strength. When something needs to be done by strength, the Master speaks through me.
Our Master has a lot of enemies in this world but he is always willing to accept friendship and shake hands with those who accept this friendship sincerely. Demon Hunters are the Master's Friends and our loyal allies. With this in mind, I have a task for you.
As you remember, Hunters swore to be allies of Soliskar the Wise on Dragon Ring. Draconids honor Great Dragons as Gods and follow their orders without question. Draconids hate Demons and can be very valuable allies... if only we would try to understand each other. This is the mission Hunters are carrying out on Draconids Island. Their progress has been rather poor so far.
Go to Draconid Island and meet Alexey Borodin, the Ambassador of the Hunters. He is trying to get on track with a local tribe of Draconids, but they are rather arrogant and hot-tempered. He will be glad to receive your help. If Draconids start to trust us, the Master will be pleased.
I am the Ambassador of Demon Hunters. We have made peace with the Draconids, but there are still some misunderstandings between us...

Did the Keeper of Strength send you? Does he really think that you can handle these scaly beasts? Oh, those bastards... Well, I really may need your help right now. These scaly things don't want to obey me at all!
Use the Signal Horn to summon your Draconid Companion and talk to Alexey Borodin.

I don't like these Draconids... I don't like them at all! They are hot-tempered and vehement. If something goes wrong they are always ready to jump on your throat! Be careful with them. Try even not to look at them. If they don't like anything about you, they will eat you! Though, I must admit, they are skillful warriors. In the upcoming battle against the Demons they will be very helpful.
So, we have no choice. Like it or not, but we have to make friends with them.
First of all, we must understand whether we can fight side by side with the Draconids. You need to see how they fight and understand if we can fight together. Prove to those scaly lizards that we know how to fight!
Here, take this horn. It is a battle horn used by Draconid scouts to send signals over a large distance. Use it to summon a Draconid to fight by your side. You will have to fight and cover each other's back. I want to be sure that you will be able to cooperate in battle. But first of all you need training.
Summon your Draconid Companion to continue our training.
What are you waiting for? Are you so excited by the importance of your mission that you can't breathe?

So, here is your companion. He's kinda small... for a Draconid, of course. Oops, my words may offend him... Indeed, he looked at me with such contempt!
Be careful, don't repeat my mistakes. Draconids don't know the meaning of many words, but they can understand intonation well. Please, be polite with them, but not too much. Let them know who is boss!
Summon your Draconid Companion and kill 5 Searing Eye Elders with his help.

So, listen carefully. Draconids are hot-tempered and undisciplined. You need to learn how to fight as a team.
Let's start with an easy task. You need to defeat a weak opponent together.
Don't forget that Draconids don't like to obey commands and they are very willful. So, don't even think that he will follow your commands.
Now let's see if he comes to help you in battle and what he will do.
Your task is to summon your Draconid Companion and kill 5 Searing Eye Elders on this island. These Searing Eyes see almost nothing, so they don't attack first and are very easy to kill even by a novice fighter.
Objectives clear? Go!
How do you like your companion? Yes, he is vehement and willful... But he is strong and agile!
So, Draconids can fight in a team. Well, that's good. Let's proceed to the second part of training!
Tactics are my forte! I was a sergeant in the Imperial Army before I joined the Hunters! Hup, two, three, four! Oh, that was so much fun...

Well, these Draconids are not stupid! I didn't expect that... Oops, I've done it again. I think I may need to change my point of view about this alliance. If trained enough, these scaly guys may become true soldiers!
Summon Draconid Companion and defeat Ghash, leader of the Dragons.

Hey, you and your scaly friend are extremely good for sabotage missions! Once you have a little more training I can send you into battle even against the most dangerous enemy.
By the way, your next opponent is very dangerous. I am talking about Ghash, leader of the Dragons, who lives in the mountains to the north of here.
Don't be afraid, it is a training fight. Draconids are related to Dragons, so, they won't kill each other. They didn't say anything about other races, though... But I believe in you!
This fight has two objectives; the second one is a hidden one... If we defeat Ghash, the strongest of all Dragons, we will show our allies that we are ready for actions and that we are strong!
So, your task is to find Ghash's lair and to defeat him together with your companion. If you succeed, it means that you have nothing left to learn and your training will be complete.
So, you failed to defeat Ghash, did you? Of course... He is a ton and five hundred kilos of pure aggression!

You surprised me... I heard you fighting. Even mountains trembled! So, you defeated Ghash, right? Great news!
Maybe, if necessary, we can make Draconids and Dragons enemies... Who knows what will happen in the future? No, I don't mean to break the alliance, but... I don't trust them! I don't believe in their loyalty! Well, it's not your problem, anyway.
But you did well! You defeated such a beast. Here is your reward. Your training is complete. Good luck to you, warriors!
Confirm that you are ready to swear to be a friend to your Draconid Companion.

Hush-sh-sh... Meatbag... You not another. Another is weak. You are strong! Me want to be friends with you! Not obey. Not follow. To friend! Like strong with strong!
Me swear. Me swear to be friend forever! Me want to be your blood brother. Like strong to strong!
You want to swear oath of friendship? You want to be friend and brother? Like strong to strong?
Good! Me swear - you listen! You swear - me listen! Both swear. Both friends. Share food. Share woman. Share enemy. My hand is your hand!
Kill 8 Lizards and bring their tails to your Draconid Companion to prove your oath.

Me swear. You swear. Good!
But swear an oath is not enough. Me talk little, do many. Do is good! Talk is bad! You do and me also do. Then we brothers and friends! Swear an oath prove with blood!
You go find lizards. Kill lizards, bring me tails! Bring three handfuls of tails! Me also go and kill. Bring you feet. You strong, me strong. We brothers and friends!
You bring tails? No? Why you wait? You not want to be friends?

Hush-sh-sh... Good! You make blood and bring me tails. Me also make blood. Here! Three handfuls of feet. Me go and kill someone like you. You go and kill someone like me. It is right!
You angry? You be not angry! Meatbag is your old fathers. Scaly is my old fathers. Kill your old fathers is bad. No need. This is why friends. Friends and brothers help each other. Me shame kill my fathers - you do it. You shame kill your fathers - me do it. Friends and brothers!
Drink 8 sips of Swamp Hydra Blood and return to your Draconid Companion. The Hydras can be found near Rusty Saltings.

Me do blood. You also do blood. Oath bound with blood. Good! But need more!
Need eat food. Brothers and friends always share food. You go find my food and eat! Me also go find your food and eat. Not like your food, but need eat. Swear. Brothers and friends!
You go to big island! Go to swamp! You kill hydra! Hydra is tasty! Gulp! You drink hydra blood. Two handfuls drink! Hydra blood tasty! But drink blood fast! When you find blood - drink!
Me also go and find your food to eat! Friends and brothers share food!
Hydra is tasty. Your food not tasty. Nut friends and brothers always share food! Me be patient. You be patient. Friends and brothers!

You, friend and brother, drink hydra blood! Tasty!
Me eat your food. Dump... Dump... Dumpling! Two handfuls of dumplings! Dumpling is bad food. Not tasty. Me eat your food. You eat my food. Friends and brothers!

Collect Mushroom Smokers from the stumps near the Citadel and throw them through the Wormfaces' ventilation grates in the Hissing Canyon. Kill 8 Wormfaces after stinking them out with smoke and return to your Draconid Companion.

We share food? Yes! Food make oath strong!
We share blood? Yes! Blood make oath strong!
My hand is your hand! We brothers and friends!
Brother and friend. You listen me. Me tell you secret. Me fight demons. You know! Me worm-on-face kill! You not know? You know!
Me hate worm-on-face. Hush-sh-sh... Worm-on-face my enemy! Our enemy! Old, old enemy! Meatbags not born my fathers worm-on-faces fight. Always fight!
You help me? Me kill worm-on-face! Me revenge! Me have fun! Kill worm-on-face go-o-o-od!
Worm-on-face hide in ground. Me know worm-on-face afraid smoke! You find mushroom! Find Mushroom Smoker. Mushroom grow on old stump. You throw mushroom in ground hole. Worm-on-face not like smoke. They go out. Worm-on-face want smoke away. You kill worm-on-face! Kill two... No, kill three handfuls! Brother and friend, kill worm-on-face. Three handfuls. Me also help you then. You say I kill three handful!
You kill my enemy. Me kill your enemy. Brothers and friends share blood, share food and share enemy!

Hush-sh-sh... brother and friend! You kill worm-on-face! You help me much. You are true brother and friend!
Me tell all you are strong. You are brother and friend. My brother-at-birth want talk to my brother and friend. Want talk you! There my friend brother stand. Talk to he!
Ask settlers of the island about Bandits, then return to the Citadel Keeper.

Greetings!
I want to ask if you know anything about the Ghost Hunters.
They are true heroes! They are a team which formed quite recently, but they already have a good reputation. They catch restless souls who couldn't return to their bodies and turned into ghosts. It is a chivalrous thing to do. They bring rest to the dead and protect those who are alive!
Recently the Ghost Hunters came to this island to help us to get rid of the ghosts of astral pirates who roam by the wreck of the astral ship to the east of here. Unfortunately, they failed.
First of all, there are too many ghosts.
Second, a gang of bandits, or "adventurers with sticky fingers" if you like, is looking for the treasure which is rumored to be hidden in the astral ship's cargo hold. They call themselves Treasure Seekers but bandits are always bandits no matter what you call them. Now these bandits are hiding somewhere by the ruins and they bother the Ghost Hunters and don't let them approach the ship. These greedy cutthroats understand that rumors about the treasure are just rumors, but ghosts, on the other hand, are really dangerous. What is even worse is that almost all newcomers believe these rumors about the treasure and join the bandits. You are not one of them, right?
Then I have a mission for you. I know some rascals who joined the bandits' gang.
Take a walk on the island and ask if anyone has seen them. Maybe we will find their hideout.
If you get any information, come to see me again.

Well, as I thought. Bandits hide very well...
Well, sooner or later we'll find their den, catch them and send them to court, quickly and fairly.

Yes, I know who you are talking about. We've captured some bandits recently, they tried to sneak into the Citadel. They called themselves Treasure Seekers. We reduced them to dust.
I doubt that anyone else would risk their lives trying to repeat their mistake.
Those who violate the Master's law will be slain!

Find the Ichor of the Undead from the Undeads infesting the ruins of the Granite Madness, and the Ghostly Warthog's Ectoplasm and Searing Eye's Ooze from near the Master's Citadel. Bring the collected ingredients to the Citadel's Keeper.

The Ghost Hunters asked me for help. Their Soul Traps require a basic Ectoplasm Charge which creates a defensive field to keep the captured ghosts inside. They also asked for some other ingredients for a spell to calm the ghosts down.
The problem is that the Ghost Hunters are very busy and the bandits looking for treasure at the wrecked ship are causing lots of problems.
To cut a long story short, the Ghost Hunters asked me to bring them the Ectoplasm and other ingredients but I have to ask for your help.
The Ghost Hunters need the Ichor of the Undead from the Undeads infesting the ruins of the Granite Madness and the Ghostly Warthog's Ectoplasm and Searing Eye's Ooze from near the Master's Citadel.
Can you help the Ghost Hunters find these ingredients and bring them to me? Of course, I will give you a generous reward.
Have you found the ingredients which the Ghost Hunters need for the spell?

Well done!
I will give these ingredients to the Hunters and they will start the ghost hunt.
I hope that after all the ghosts are trapped nobody will groan in the Citadel at night or sing dirty sailor songs.
Find and kill four Treasure Seekers hiding somewhere on the island. Then return to the Citadel's Keeper.

The Ghost Hunters told me that they are almost ready to start the hunt. I hope that they succeed and that the ghosts never bother us again.
I am worried about the band of Treasure Seekers. They will definitely try to get in the Ghost Hunters' way. We must strike a preventive hit.
As far as I know, bandits have some hideouts on the island where they meet before a raid. I don't know how many hideouts there are on the island or where they'll be meeting today... My scouts reported about 4 Treasure Seekers but they were spotted and ran away.
If you want to help me you will have to run around the island. Four Treasure Seekers are hiding somewhere on the Island. Find and kill all bandits planning the raid! Only when the Ghost Hunters are sure that nobody will interrupt them will they start their ghost hunt.
Gold fever makes everyone lose their head... As a wise man from the past and from another world said, "People die for metal" - and he was right!

All four are dead? Good.
No, I'm not happy when sentient beings die, but these bandits crossed the line! Gold fever makes their minds blind...
Complete the tasks of Citadel's Keeper and choose your reward.

Have you met the Ghost Hunters? These guys arrived here to catch the lost sparks that disturb the living ones.
Their leader, Iron Hoof the minotaur is searching for help, but first he needs to make sure the candidate can be trusted. If you help the Ghost Hunters to get rid of the bandits and find the ingredients for their potion, Iron Hoof will welcome you at the hunt.
Ghost hunt is honorable but not easy. It can only occur at nighttime. When you complete my tasks, you will have to decide if you want to receive your reward at once or participate in the hunt. Destroy the bandits and collect the components, and I will give you either a Ghost Hunter's Credentials that invite you to the hunt, or a valuable scroll with ancient knowledge.
I have just one more thing to add: if you take part in the hunt and the hunt is successful, your reward will be much more precious. But such a hunt is not for everyone...

So, a scroll with ancient knowledge will immediately give you some experience points. If you choose the certificate, you can participate in an exciting hunt. Some people want to receive everything right now, and others don't look for easiest way... You are to choose.

Using the Ghost Trap, catch 30 ghosts haunting the Astral Coast near the wrecked ship and release them in the Spectral Prison. Then talk to Iron Hoof.
To catch a Ghost, reduce its health to 25% and use two artifacts. Different types of Ghosts require different artifacts.
You should use the Astral Splitter and Spectral Energy Absorber to catch a Shipwright's Ghost.
To catch a Cannoneer's Ghost, you will need a Spectral Energy Absorber and High-Frequency Generator.
To catch a Steersman's Ghost, you should use a High-Frequency Generator and Astral Splitter.
These devices can be used in any order. After you have used two devices use Ghost Trap to catch a ghost.

Let the hunt begin!
Have you-u-u ever hunted ghoo-o-osts before? If it is your first hunt, talk to me, I'll explain the details to you-u-u. Now listen.
Ghosts haunt the coast near the wrecked ship but sometimes penetrate into ru-u-uins. There are a lot of ru-u-uins here. You must catch at least 30 Ghosts. The more the better. Why at least 30 Ghosts? Because you-u-u can't keep mo-o-ore ghosts in a portable trap. When you have caught enough, bring them here. This ro-o-ound glo-o-owing thing next to me isn't just a thing! It is Spectral Prison. It can contain thousands of Gho-o-osts! Or maybe less, I didn't check... A couple of hundred, for sure!
So, you go and catch the ghosts. When you have caught 30 gho-o-osts, approach the Prison and release them there. When you are done, talk to me and I will give you your reward. If you want to go-o-o on, you are welcome! There are enough ghosts for everyone!
As one of my friends says, the mo-o-ore you bring - the mo-o-ore you get!
Remember, you need an Astral Splitter and Spectral Energy Abso-o-orber to catch a Shipwright's Gho-o-ost. If you are after a Cannoneer's Gho-o-ost, prepare your Spectral Energy Abso-o-orber and High-Frequency Generator. To catch a Steersman's Gho-o-ost you need the Generator and the Splitter. Do-o-on't forget the Trap!
So-o-o? Ho-o-ow did you like the hunt? It was so-o-o exciting, right? And also very useful for everyone!

Wo-o-ow, you are go-o-od! We caught so-o-o many ghosts with your help!
So-o-o, here is your reward. If you want to go on hunting, talk to me!
Bring Ghost Hunter's Credentials to Iron Hoof.

So, now you have the Ghost Hunter's Credential, you can participate in the Ghost Hunt!
Believe me, it is a very important mission and the Ghost Hunters don't reveal their secrets to any stranger. They are proud and cautious. You have proved your loyalty and gained Credentials... don't waste your chance now.
By taking part in the hunt you are not only helping the Citadel, but also securing the coast against annoying ghosts and earning valuable experience which will help you in your future adventures. Of course, the Ghost Hunters will reward you!
Go to the Ghost Hunter's Camp. Iron Hoof, their leader, is waiting for you.
He has problems with remembering faces. Just show him the paper with your name, otherwise he wouldn't even want to talk to you.

So-o-o, you are the hero who helped us to get rid of the Treasure Seekers and found the required reagents for the ritual? Well, thank you-u-u!
There is a saying in the Dead Sea region that you can't drink "thanks" fro-o-om a bottle... so I think everybo-o-ody will support me if I give you a share of the go-o-old found on the ship. but don't tell anyone there was gold on the ship, otherwise do-o-ozens of idiots will jo-o-oin the Treasure Seekers and they will finally drive us away fro-o-om here. We still haven't completed o-o-our mission here.
Do-o-o you really want to participate in the hunt? We hunt ghosts every night and give abundant rewards to those who-o-o catch them! To-o-o take part in the hunt you need our trust and Credentials. I don't want a Treasure Seeker to pretend to be our friend, only to break our valuable equipment.
So-o-o, every time you will have to bring us new Credentials. Nothing personal, we need this fo-o-or o-o-our safety. Only then can we be sure that you are our friend!
Why are you disturbing me? I am busy! I have no-o-o time for stupid questions!

Stay right there! Thief, I'll kill you!
Wait, you are not one of them! Weeell... I'm sorry. My mistake...
My name is Iron Hoof, the Ghost Hunter. I hunt ghosts, spirits and other evil beings. How may I help?

So, you want to save the innocent victim? How generous and kind of you! But before you rush to slaughter the lizards, let me give you a piece of advice.
The Altar and its guardians are protected by unknown and strange spell. With every single lizard slain, these protective powers weaken. You will see it yourself when you slay at least a dozen of them. If you manage to break their defenses, you will save the innocent victim and get the reward.
But you are not the only hero willing to save the girl. There are others who will try to get in your way using a special ability that pushes the competitors back from the victim. You can use it against your opponents, too, but every time you do so, the defenses will grow stronger, and you will have to kill the lizards again. Anyway, your rival's situation will become even worse...
Don't waste your time if you want to save the girl. Better let someone else do the job instead of leaving her to die!
Get aboard the Astral Barge and go on a journey. Listen to Gorislav carefully. He might want to tell you something very important.

I like to send letters. No, really. I have a feeling that in the future sentient beings will forget how to write letters... They will find other ways to send information. A letter will no longer be associated with white paper, fancy handwriting, envelopes and beautiful stamps which smell of glue. A letter will become a data pack, pure information sent from a sender to a recipient... That doesn't sound much fun... don't you agree? Hopefully, that time won't come too soon.
Anyway, I digress. So, you are here because of my letter. You are wondering what I might need from you, right? I need a little favor. I need to crack the shell in which you, beings who inhabit Sarnaut, hide in since birth: You don't notice obvious things. You are so comfortable living in a world of illusions and sweet lies that only a decent kick will make you think again. I am going to kick you with my leg, ha!
I didn't mean to kick you literally. But there are some people I want to kick so hard... And then punch their empty heads. No-no, I'm not talking about you.
So, the time to reveal mysteries and punish the guilty ones has come. The final scene of the greatest play in the world is about to begin!
Get aboard the Astral Barge and make yourself comfortable. We are leaving! Where are we going? It's a surprise! I like surprises, you know.
I will reveal some details of the plot while we are sailing. I'll be your guide, ha ha!
You have the great honor of hearing the Truth from the Master himself!

When the time comes, go to the ruins to the north-east of the Citadel to save the innocent victim. Then talk to the Citadel Keeper, irrespective of whether you succeed or not.
You must kill enough lizards to save the victim.
You can prevent other players from saving the victim by using your "Get lost!" ability.

Have you ever felt pity or compassion? Do you feel strong enough to punish evil and protect the innocent? I believe that in spite of dozens of bloody battles and hundreds of enemies killed by your hands, your heart hasn't withered. I believe that you can complete my task.
Lizards in the ruins to the north-east of the Citadel are planning something evil. They are worshiping some vile blood-thirsty god with an unutterable name and offer him numerous sacrifices. I don't know the name of the god, but it's of no importance.
What IS important is that the lizards captured several beautiful girls who arrived here in search of... ahem... revelation. So, these cold-blooded beasts are going to kill them, to offer them as a sacrifice to their god. Imagine that: blood of a young lady splashed over a cold stone altar slab... Even I feel scared, though I don't have any blood at all.
The hero who saves at least one innocent victim will receive a reward from me. Also, everyone who tries to save them will earn valuable combat experience and my gratitude.
It is known that lizards start their rituals according to their own time schedule. Make sure you check your calendar regularly. We will let you know when it is time to challenge these cold-blooded killers.
And one more thing! Before you save a victim on the altar, kill as many lizards as you can... otherwise they will try to get in your way or simply try to kill the girl. I don't mind if you decrease the lizards' population.
To pray to false gods is stupid; to offer them a sacrifice is a crime!
Well, you deserve your reward. I hope the lizards will remember this lesson and won't try to repeat the ritual for a while.
Find Maurice de Vevre at the Historians' Camp.

I am the Keeper of Wisdom. When it is time to put swords aside and use wisdom collected over thousands of years, the Master speaks through me.
Here, in the Citadel, there are a lot of wanderers looking for the Truth. Most of them are like you: they are adventurers brought here by the wind of war. They dream of victory. But there are also strangers who want to perceive ancient wisdom and knowledge. You've already heard about them. They are the Historians who collect crumbs of knowledge. It is no surprise that they've gladly joined the search for Truth - the Truth which the Master wants to reveal to the world.
While there are beings in the world who search for ancient wisdom, there are also beings who possess it. I mean the Wormfaces. Even I cannot explain all their actions, but they revere the Master and ceased hostilities against the Seekers of Truth when the Master asked them. Wormfaces know part of the Truth which you are looking for, but they are not willing to share it. Therefore I have an errand for you.
The representative of the Historians, Maurice de Vevre, is very close to establishing contact with those hostile creatures. But now he is experiencing some difficulties and is asking for help. The Historians know a lot about you and you used to help them before, so they won't mind working with you.
Maurice de Vevre is at the Historians' Camp to the east of the Citadel. Hurry up! He is already waiting for you.

Greetings. I am the Ambassador of Historians who arrived here with a scientific mission. We Historians are interested in the Wormfaces. We have information that they are one of the most ancient creatures of Sarnaut, who existed in the centuries of the Junes!

You've been sent here by the Keeper of Wisdom? You are just on time!
We are having a communication problem... The Wormfaces don't want to talk to us!
Pass on the words of the Seventeenth to Maurice de Vevre.

I am the Seventeenth and I assure you that I don't care about the Junes' rubbish! Or did you think that because we needed wreck samples for study, it might be for something other than just scientific research?
Do you want to burn them? Burn them! Do you want to shatter them? Shatter them! Do you want to throw them into the Astral? I know a great way how you can do it.
We don't care about fragments of the past. You can tell the Elf what I've just said!
Have you talked to the Wormface? So, tell me, what did he say?

He really said that? Shatter, destroy, throw into the Astral? They don't care?! It can't be!
No, I can't be wrong... Their indifference is a lie!
Bring 5 pieces of Kindling and prepare a fireplace by the statue. Use the Talk-back Device to threaten the Seventeenth again.

I got it!
The Wormfaces are playing a childish game to check whether our nerves are made of steel or not! They must be bluffing. Why should they believe us?
But if you show them that we really mean to destroy the statue... Yes... So, I may need your help.
Walk around and collect 10 pieces of Kindling. Put them by the statue. Let them see that we are not joking!
Then ask that snob on the other side of the door if he really wants to see that beautiful statue destroyed!
Are you really going to burn the statue? Wow... We thought you were all talk and no action.
Bring Kindling Liquid to Maurice de Vevre.

I tell you what. I am tired of all your stupid games with the statue.
If you want to burn it then burn it and stop wasting my time!
Or you gonna tell me that the wood is wet and you can't set it on fire? I can help you. Take our special Kindling Liquid made from Black Blood of Earth. Believe me, you can even make snow burn with it!
Bring this Liquid to the stupid Elf. Let him burn the statue and get out of here!
I hope that the Wormfaces believe our little lie and stop pretending to be indifferent.
Such a jerk! His bluff is so natural... He is so confident as if he absolutely doesn't care about that statue!
Start the fire by the statue, see what happens and then talk to the Wormface using the Talk-back Device again.

But what if... But what if this statue means absolutely nothing to them? It is an ancient monument... What shall we do?
No! We'll go on until the end! If we have to burn the statue to make these cold-blooded bastards show their true feelings we will do it!
I mean, you will do it... I wouldn't dare.
Go, burn! But let me turn away so I don't have to watch a masterpiece of art being burnt to ashes! Then no one will see my tears...
I am the Second Command. You and the Elf have gone too far. We have to intervene!
Talk to Maurice de Vevre and make sure that he remembers nothing about what happened in the last hours. Then talk to the Second Command using the Talk-back Device.

We don't trust these Historians, you know. Professionals never trust amateurs, but these Historians are real amateurs when it comes to matters of history.
When we understood that you were going to destroy a masterpiece of June art, we couldn't let it happen. We are sorry that we had to put you and everyone else around down. But we couldn't let you destroy the piece of art.
We changed something in the minds of the others while they were asleep. Nobody except for you will remember about this statue and about our concerns about the Junes' legacy. Why didn't we change your memory? Because you've proved your desire to cooperate and your loyalty. We are ready to forgive you for this affair with the statue. We are also guilty in it. The Overmind, which is the Council of our race, decided to reveal one of our mysteries to you.
But before we tell you the true story, please, check if the Elf remembers anything about what happened recently.
What happened to the Elf? Until we are sure that he does not remember anything, the mystery will remain a mystery.

The Elf remembers nothing. Good job. Listen!
Yes, we collect and preserve the Junes' legacy. It is our past. Every shard, every sculpture and every bas-relief is a piece of history and symbol of our magnificence and might. This magnificence was lost...
We are not indifferent about our past. We suffered enough pain and grief. This pain cannot be forgotten over time... It gives a special flavor to revenge. You might have heard a saying of those who live on the ground: Revenge is a dish best served cold.
Our utmost desire is to take revenge upon the Great Dragons! These cursed beasts hunted us like a prey! They've killed thousands and hundreds of thousands of us. Truly cursed was the day we decided that we can choose the fate of this world.
Today we are forced to make friends with the Draconids, who were created by our old enemies! Such irony... What is worst of all is that we don't have a choice other than to obey...
Don't ask any more questions. There is time for everything. When the Overmind decides it is time to tell you more, I will talk to you again. But for now, good-bye.
